newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares surge to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares surge to new highs.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial shares rose more than three percent on Monday as they continued a heady bullrun which brokers said should gain further momentum from latest consumer inflation figures.
The key 57-share industrial index shot up 217.65 points -- its largest climb ever on a single day -- to break through the 7,000 psychological barrier, closing at an unprecedented 7,114.80.
"The market is becoming a madhouse. It's just incredible," one broker said.

Another broker said he expected industrial shares to maintain their upward march on the back of further good news on Monday of annual inflation falling to 17.7 percent in August from 22 percent in July.

The market's bull-run was sparked in mid-August by prospects of falling inflation and declining interest rates as well as an increase to 40 percent from 35 percent in the amount of total shareholding foreign investors are now allowed to hold in a listed company.

"I'm sure it will still go up when the news of the further fall in inflation in August filters through. It will come down at some point but we don't know when or what will trigger it now, maybe a bad rainy season," he said.
On the bourse on Monday, sugar refinery ZSR led the winners, surging 200 cents to 1,400, while winery Afdis and pottery-maker Ariston leapt 100 cents each to 500 and 1,300 respectively.

Blue-chip conglomerate Delta at 3,200, pork processor Colcom at 320 and cement producer Porthold all rose 30 cents, multi-industrial group Tedco climbed 45 cents to 455, while 40-cent gains were recorded in sugar producer Hippo at 840, packaging firm Hunyani at 350 and tobacco company TSL at 510.
Tyre manufacturers Dunlop and Alloys added 20 cents each to 220 and 920 respectively.

Minings were less active with nickel giant Bindura and Wankie Colliery trading unchanged at previous prices while Falgold put on 15 cents to 200. The seven-counter mining index gained 9.93 points to 1,415.28.
